g.title: dispatchMain admits init and calls handleInit; handleInit performs installation through archiveWorkForInit and installCandidate and returns the selected command result. This shared entry point binds the existing IF-006 behavior without adding another public command catalog.
installCandidate implements the candidate-unit destination boundary invoked by handleInit; returned or thrown completion/retention facts shape its public result.
